evidence.quote: Within each affected quarter, repeated nonzero fair values identify the same position under a detailed member and a shortened member: e.g. 2023-06 SP-CREH 19 Highline LLC FV 20,925,450 appears twice, and 2024-06 Universal Entertainment/Japan Senior Secured Bonds FV 21,802,799 appears twice.

Duplicate FV impact exactly equals the held-out FV overshoot in 2023-06 (40,890,051), 2023-09 (54,168,657), and 2023-12 (52,948,918); after subtotal removal it also closes the later affected quarters to rounding.

rationale: Legacy extraction emitted the same investment once under its full investment identifier and again under a shortened axis representation. Exact quarter and nonzero fair value is an auditable duplicate key for this bounded historical scope; zero-value positions are excluded from deduplication because equal zero values are not evidence of duplication.
